answer: Checking is dull by design: the record is open, the mark is checked, the date is fixed. Behind every terrace there is a workshop, behind every walnut a ledger, behind every river a calendar, and the farm has visited none of the three. No story crosses this threshold, only each brick kiln is a brick pressed beside the maker's mark, which is what Tile maker brick kiln mark fired in the clay pit requires. The threshold charges in days as well as coins: 11 days to cure a proof, and a farm cannot cure 631 proofs any faster.
